capabilities: add a configured property to all notes linking to the current note
remove that property value from all backlinking notes
append values to existing list properties without duplicates
set the property name used for tagging
extras: Requires Obsidian v1.4.4 or later because it uses the FileManager.processFrontMatter API.
problem: Obsidian shows backlinks but offers no way to write that relationship into note properties in bulk.
summary: Command-based tool that adds or removes a frontmatter property on every note linking to the current note, using the note's name as the value.
